title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Allergies
intro: Herbal creams for Allergies are topical ointments or creams that contain plant-based extracts to help alleviate symptoms of allergies, such as itching, redness, and swelling. These creams work by soothing and calming the skin, reducing inflammation and providing relief from allergy-related discomfort. Benefits of using herbal creams for allergies include the natural and non-invasive approach to treatment, as well as the reduction of reliance on pharmaceutical medications. Examples of herbal creams for allergies include Aloe vera, Chamomile, Calendula, Lavender, and Echinacea, all of which are known for their anti-inflammatory and antihistamine properties, while also promoting skin health and preventing further irritation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat allergies by soothing and calming the skin, reducing inflammation and itching. The properties of this herbal preparation that help to treat this ailment include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and moisturizing properties, which work together to provide relief from allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis creams, such as flavonoids, triterpenoids, and carotenoids, help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and promote healing of the skin. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat allergies include reduced redness and swelling, relief from itching and irritation, and a decrease in the risk of further allergic reactions.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Roumanian archives of microbiology and immunology", Calendula officinalis creams for allergies may be beneficial due to the significant antioxidant activity of Calendula officinalis, which helps to modulate the respiratory burst of human activated neutrophils and scavenge reactive oxygen species, potentially reducing inflammation and alleviating allergic symptoms.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been used for centuries as a natural remedy to alleviate allergy symptoms. The anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce swelling and modulate the immune response, providing relief from itchy eyes, runny nose, and sneezing. The bioactive constituents, including alkylamides, glycosides, and phenolic acids, in Echinacea purpurea creams work synergistically to inhibit the release of histamine and other chemical mediators that contribute to allergic reactions. By using Echinacea purpurea creams, individuals can experience a reduction in allergy symptoms, improved respiratory function, and a boost in their overall immune system, making it a popular natural remedy for allergy sufferers.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Echinacea purpurea creams for allergies may have potential as an adjuvant symptomatic therapy due to the presence of bioactive compounds in the plant.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams, derived from the gel of the aloe vera plant, have been widely used to treat various skin allergies and ailments due to their soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. The cream's ability to reduce redness, swelling, and itching helps to provide relief from allergy symptoms, making it an effective natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of aloe vera, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, contribute to its therapeutic effects by reducing inflammation and promoting skin healing. By using aloe barbadensis creams, individuals can benefit from its anti-allergic and anti-inflammatory properties, leading to improved skin health and reduced symptoms of allergies.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Aloe barbadensis creams for allergies may be beneficial due to its reported antiallergic and anti-histaminic properties, which help in preventing mast cells from releasing histamine, thereby reducing allergic reactions.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams have been traditionally used to treat allergy-related ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and decongestant properties. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, including eucalyptol, limonene, and beta-pinene, help to alleviate symptoms such as congestion and itching, thereby providing relief from allergies. The eucalyptol content in these creams is known to exhibit expectorant properties, which aid in loosening and expelling mucus from the respiratory tract, making breathing easier. By using Eucalyptus globulus creams, individuals can experience a range of benefits, including reduced allergy symptoms, improved respiratory function, and enhanced overall well-being.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "The Journal of asthma : official journal of the Association for the Care of Asthma", Eucalyptus globulus creams for allergies may provide relief of symptoms related to allergic reactions, such as rhinorrhea, sneezing, and itching, possibly by acting as an antagonist to asthma mediators like histamine.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been used traditionally to treat allergies due to their anti-inflammatory and antihistamine properties. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been shown to possess antiallergic and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to their therapeutic benefits. The use of Lavandula angustifolia creams as a topical treatment for allergies has been found to provide relief from symptoms and promote overall well-being.

By using Urtica dioica creams, individuals can experience relief from allergic reactions and enjoy the benefits of a natural and non-invasive treatment option.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Pharmaceutical biology", Urtica dioica creams for allergies may be effective in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in individuals with allergies, as evidenced by the significant inhibition of eosinophilia increases and lipid peroxidation in an asthmatic rat model.

The bioactive constituents of Hypericum perforatum creams, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthodianthrones, contribute to their therapeutic effects by modulating the immune response and reducing oxidative stress. The benefits of using Hypericum perforatum creams to treat skin allergies include reduced inflammation, improved skin health, and a decrease in the severity of symptoms, making it a popular natural remedy for this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Frontiers in pharmacology", Hypericum perforatum creams for allergies are traditionally used to treat skin problems such as eczema, wounds, and insect stings.

The anti-inflammatory and antihistamine properties of Sambucus nigra creams help to reduce swelling and itching in the nasal passages and eyes, providing relief from allergy symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Sambucus nigra creams, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sambunigrin, contribute to their therapeutic effects by inhibiting the release of histamine and other allergic mediators. By using Sambucus nigra creams, individuals can benefit from their natural and non-invasive approach to treating allergies, reducing the need for pharmaceutical medications and their potential side effects.

The benefits of using Artemisia absinthium creams to treat allergies include rapid relief, reduced risk of medication side effects, and a natural, non-invasive approach to managing this common health issue.
